parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage furniture, made of plywood with a rectangular shape and compartments for storage.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal compartments and door, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet, typically hinged or sliding, with a handle for operation.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior compartments and protects stored items from dust and exposure.
parts.Movement_description: The door can rotate or swing open and closed around its hinges or slide along a track, depending on the design.
